# platform.AdminSchedule

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A platform or tenant schedule as staff see it, with its state and next fire.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.AdminSchedule` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.workflow.manage` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the schedule was created (UTC). |  |
| `createdBy` | yes | `personal` | Creator of a tenant schedule; null for platform ones. |  |
| `cron` | yes | `none` | 5-field cron expression, evaluated in `timezone`. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Schedule id. |  |
| `lastFireAt` | yes | `none` | Last fire (UTC); null before the first. |  |
| `nextFireAt` | yes | `none` | Next fire (UTC); null while paused. |  |
| `scope` | yes | `none` | `platform` for the core crons, `tenant` for a schedule of an organization. |  |
| `status` | yes | `none` | `paused` schedules do not fire. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization that owns a tenant schedule; null for platform ones. |  |
| `timezone` | yes | `none` | IANA time zone of the cron expression. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the schedule last changed (UTC). |  |
| `workflowId` | yes | `none` | Scheduled workflow. |  |

## Relations

_None._
